Required Skills:

Degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, or IT.
Strong understanding of agentic AI fundamentalsgoal definition, planning, reasoning, task decomposition, and autonomous action loops.
Design and build agentic workflows using LLMs, including tool/function calling, state management, memory, and orchestration patterns (single-agent/multi-agent).
Hands-on experience with agent frameworks and patterns (e.g., LangChain-based agent frameworks or equivalents), including routing, workflows, and agent coordination.
Model Context Protocol (MCP) proficiency for integrating tools and contextual data into agent workflows (tool discovery/usage via MCP servers).
Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and grounding strategies for enterprise knowledge sources (e.g., internal repos/wikis/ticketing/content stores) to improve agent reliability.
Agent observability & monitoring (AgentOps): track agent behavior, tool calls, outcomes, and quality signals; implement alerts/traces and feedback loops for continuous improvement.
Cloud and/or platform engineering exposure for deploying agentic systems at scale (containers/Kubernetes/OpenShift, CI/CD, performance tuning, and secure operations).
Responsible AI & guardrails: design human-in-the-loop controls, safe tool access, and security-aware policies for agents operating with credentials, data access, and budgets.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, .Net or Java, with experience in relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras).

Educational Requirements

Bachelor of Engineering,BCA,BSc

Service Line

Topaz COE unit

Responsibilities

Design and implement advanced Generative AI models to solve complex problems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into existing systems.
Conduct research and stay updated with the latest advancements in NLP and AI technologies.
Develop scalable and efficient AI algorithms to enhance product offerings.
Mentor junior team members and share knowledge to foster a culture of learning.

Additional Responsibilities:

Bachelor's degree in Technology (B.Tech) or related field.
5+ years of experience in Generative AI, NLP, and Artificial Intelligence.
Proven track record of successfully deploying AI models in production environments.

Technical and Professional Requirements:

- Primary skills: Machine Learning->Generative AI-> Agentic AI-> Large Language Models-> NLP-> Artificial Intelligence

Preferred Skills:

Technology->AI-Agentic AI->Agent Engineering

Agentic AI Engineer

Experience: 4-8 Years
Location: Indore/Bengaluru/Hyderabad /Pune.
Employment Type: Full-Time / Contract / Contract-to-Hire

We are seeking an experienced Agentic AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy intelligent AI agents capable of autonomous reasoning, planning, tool usage, and workflow automation. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python, Large Language Models (LLMs), and modern AI frameworks to build scalable, production-ready AI applications.

The candidate should have hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases such as Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, or FAISS, and prompt engineering. Strong knowledge of multi-agent systems, AI orchestration, memory management, tool calling, and agent evaluation is essential.

Experience with FastAPI, REST APIs, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is required. Familiarity with databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Redis, along with messaging technologies like Kafka or RabbitMQ, will be an added advantage.

The ideal candidate should have excellent problem-solving skills, experience integrating AI agents with enterprise applications, optimizing performance and security, monitoring AI systems, and collaborating with cross-functional teams in Agile environments to deliver reliable, scalable, and innovative AI-powered solutions.

Roles and Responsibilities


Design, develop, and deploy NLP models using Agentic AI platform.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate NLP solutions into existing systems.

Develop high-quality code in Python and Azure environment.

We are looking for a GenAI Engineer with hands-on experience in Generative AI and/or Agentic AI to design and develop enterprise-grade AI solutions. The role involves building LLM-powered applications, AI agents, RAG pipelines, and intelligent automation workflows. The ideal candidate should have strong Python development skills and experience with modern LLM/agent frameworks. You will work closely with product and engineering teams to take GenAI use cases from prototype to production.




Roles & Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI and Agentic AI applications using LLMs and modern AI frameworks.
Build AI agents and multi-agent workflows with tool/function calling, reasoning, planning, and orchestration.
Develop RAG-based solutions including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, and vector search.
Integrate LLMs such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or equivalent models into enterprise applications.
Develop and integrate LLM tools, APIs, and external services to enable agent-driven workflows.
Implement prompt engineering, context management, structured outputs, and guardrails.
Build scalable Python-based APIs and backend services for GenAI applications.
Evaluate and optimize LLM applications for accuracy, latency, cost, reliability, and hallucination reduction.
Implement observability and evaluation using tools such as LangSmith, MLflow, or equivalent.
Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to translate use cases into production-ready AI solutions.
Deploy GenAI solutions using cloud, Docker, CI/CD, and modern software engineering practices.



Requirements

Mandatory hands-on experience in Generative AI or Agentic AI development.
Strong programming experience in Python.
Hands-on experience with LLMs and LLM application development.
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar agent frameworks.
Strong understanding of RAG architecture, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
Experience with AI agents, tool/function calling, agent orchestration, and multi-step workflows.
Strong knowledge of prompt engineering and LLM context management.
Experience integrating LLM APIs and third-party APIs/services.
Experience developing REST APIs and production-grade backend services.
Understanding of LLM evaluation, hallucination mitigation, guardrails, and responsible AI practices.
Experience with at least one cloud platform AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Good understanding of Git, Docker, CI/CD, testing, and software engineering best practices.



Good to Have

Experience with multi-agent systems.
Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol).
Experience with fine-tuning / LoRA / model customization.
Experience with Azure AI / AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex AI.
Experience with Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, Chroma, Milvus, or similar vector databases.
Experience with LLM observability and evaluation frameworks.
Experience building enterprise GenAI solutions in production.
